selected_object.label: Vintage Die-Cast Hot Rod
selected_object.description: Heavy zinc-alloy classic speedster with flame decals and reckless momentum.

whimsical_role: V8 Supercharged Battering Ram & Alien Dragster

announcer_lines.intro: VINTAGE DIE-CAST HOT ROD DRAFTED! Rev the engine and brace for reckless arcade physics.

round1.intro: WRECK THE HOUSE: Floor the pedal on the wrecking chain and crash the haunted mansion!
round1.win: SPEED LIMIT VIOLATION: The manor collapsed into kindling! 500 horsepower ghost eviction!
round1.lose: STALLED OUT: The Victorian walls survived your metal bumper. Check the spark plugs!

round2.intro: ALIEN SPEED TRAP: The UFO radar clocked your hot rod at Mach 2! Align under the tractor beam.
round2.win: INTERGALACTIC TOW TRUCK: Aliens beamed up the hot rod to join the mothership drag race!
round2.lose: RADAR DETECTOR WORKED: The UFO beam missed! You outran the alien speed patrol!

round3.intro: VOLCANO DRAG STRIP: Dodge high-velocity molten boulders on the magma superhighway!
round3.win: SMOKING TIRES: You drifted past the eruption and reached the checkered flag alive!
round3.lose: BLOWN GASKET: A giant magma rock flattened your hot rod chassis. Totaled!

announcer_lines.summary: SPEED DEMON INCIDENT: The die-cast racer survived supernatural demolition, alien abduction and volcanic drag racing.
